name: EULER
description: Manage your partner program and access your Partner Data Lake with Claude — instant actions and answers on deals, commissions, onboarding, and partner performance, no dashboard required. Partners can register deals and access live data across their pipeline, enablement, certifications, payouts and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add EULER to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add EULER to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.eulerapp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the EULER MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: EULER lists 20 MCP tools, including ping, list_accounts, partners, partner_directory_search, partner_artifacts, referrals, submit_referral, company_deals, company_invoices, charges_lookup, flow_lifecycle, and flow_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to EULER?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to EULER in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
EULER requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
EULER is developed by Euler Software Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
